title: checkpoint
description: Save, Teleport, and Clone: The Ultimate Multi-Version Checkpoint Manager.
body:
Overview
minecraft-checkpoint is a high-performance, persistent checkpoint management system designed for Spigot and Paper servers. Whether you are running a parkour server or a complex adventure map, this plugin provides a seamless way for players to save, manage, and share their locations across all major Minecraft versions (1.8.x, 1.12.x, and 1.21.x).

Key Features

Full Multi-Version Support: Native compatibility with 1.8.x, 1.12.x, and 1.21.x.

Persistent Storage: All checkpoint data, including selection states and clone history, is automatically saved and persists across server restarts.

Advanced GUI: A feature-rich 54-slot chest UI with 7 sorting options, real-time search, and clear-status visualization.

Precision Tracking: Records X/Y/Z and Facing (yaw) to 5 decimal places for pixel-perfect teleports.

Social & Cloning: Browse other players' checkpoints and clone them to your own list with a single click.

Intuitive Item Controls: Quick-save and teleport using dedicated utility items like Slime Balls and Nether Stars.

Seamless i18n: Automatically detects player client locale for Japanese and English support.
